sentiment_score_definition: x <= -0.35: Bearish; -0.35 < x <= -0.15: Somewhat-Bearish; -0.15 < x < 0.15: Neutral; 0.15 <= x < 0.35: Somewhat_Bullish; x >= 0.35: Bullish

feed.title: Corbus Pharmaceuticals to Host Conference Call to Discuss Topline Data from CANYON-1 Clinical Trial and the Potential of CRB-913 In Obesity
feed.summary: Corbus Pharmaceuticals will host a conference call and webcast on Monday, September 14, 2026, to discuss topline data from its CANYON-1 Phase 1b clinical trial of CRB-913 for obesity. CRB-913 is a peripherally restricted CB1 inverse agonist, offering a potentially new approach to weight management. Dr. Harold Bays, an investigator for the study, will be a guest speaker, providing expert insight into the clinical trial findings and the potential of CRB-913.

feed.title: Greenwave Technology Solutions raises $3.75 million in private placement of preferred stock
feed.summary: Greenwave Technology Solutions (NASDAQ:GWAV) has completed a private placement, raising $3.75 million through the issuance of Series B Convertible Preferred Stock to five institutional investors. The preferred shares, priced at $1,000 each, are convertible into common stock at $5.24 per share and come with specific conditions regarding conversion, voting rights, and dividend payments. This financing was conducted under Section 4(a)(2) of the Securities Act of 1933 and Rule 506 of Regulation D.

feed.title: How Much Do You Really Need Invested in Bristol Myers Squibb to Collect $10,000 a Year?
feed.summary: This article calculates the investment needed in Bristol Myers Squibb (BMY) to generate $10,000 in annual dividend income, highlighting that it requires approximately 3,968 shares or $252,000 at the current 3.94% yield. It also warns about the significant risk posed by BMY's looming patent cliff for its drug Eliquis, which could impact the company's ability to fund dividends. The article emphasizes BMY's strong balance sheet and growth portfolio as potential mitigating factors against these patent expiration risks.

feed.title: Can Fabrinet (NYSE:FN) Turn Scale Into an Advantage?
feed.summary: Fabrinet (NYSE:FN) is being assessed in the current macro environment, characterized by elevated energy costs, firm Treasury yields, and renewed inflation concerns. The article highlights that Fabrinet's business profile, focusing on operational scale, niche market share, margin discipline, and expansion across established end markets, positions it relevantly within the Midcap Stocks sector. The discussion emphasizes how the company's execution and business mechanics are critical in navigating volatile input costs, uneven demand, and changing financial conditions, rather than relying solely on broad market sentiment.

feed.title: Nvidia-Digital Realty AI Factory Buildout Runs Into Grid-Level Financing Test
feed.summary: Nvidia and Digital Realty's joint AI factory project, which includes a nearly 100-megawatt research facility in Manassas, Virginia, is facing grid-level financing challenges that have pushed its launch to later in 2026. Despite a recent $150 million financing round for Emerald AI, the core issue lies in operating AI infrastructure within power grid constraints while maintaining performance, rather than a simple funding shortfall. This situation signals potential friction in scaling AI infrastructure, which could impact GPU access for cloud providers and enterprises.

feed.title: Kimberly-Clark's 54-Year Dividend Streak Faces Its Biggest Test Yet With $48.7 Billion Kenvue Deal
feed.summary: Kimberly-Clark (KMB) recently extended its 54-year dividend increase streak while simultaneously pursuing a $48.7 billion acquisition of Kenvue (KVUE), raising concerns among income investors. The company's operating cash flow barely covers its current dividend and capital expenditure, and the Kenvue deal is expected to put significant pressure on its balance sheet. While management expresses confidence in synergies from the acquisition, the market is pricing in real risk, as KMB shares have fallen 20% over the past year, pushing its dividend yield to 5%.

feed.title: Anchorage Digital Bank, BitGo join Coinbase to custody 21Shares crypto ETFs
feed.summary: Asset manager 21Shares has added Anchorage Digital Bank and BitGo as new custodians for its spot cryptocurrency exchange-traded funds (ETFs), joining existing custodian Coinbase. This move aims to diversify custody partners, minimizing single points of failure for its ARK 21Shares Bitcoin ETF and 21Shares Core Ethereum ETF. The decision aligns with increasing scrutiny from the SEC on client asset custody and reflects a trend among institutional crypto companies towards regulated, secure storage solutions.

feed.title: Reliance Global Group director Blumenfrucht sells $35,040 in stock By Investing.com
feed.summary: Alex Blumenfrucht, a director at Reliance Global Group, Inc. (NASDAQ:EZRA), sold 8,830 shares of the company's common stock for approximately $35,040 on August 3, 2026. This transaction occurred after a modification to a previous restricted stock grant accelerated the vesting of shares. Following the sale, Blumenfrucht holds 13 shares in the company, which recently reported a narrower net loss in Q2 2026 due to expense reduction and AI platform advancements, despite a revenue decline.

feed.summary: Dollar General and Dollar Tree both reported strong second-quarter results, beating expectations. However, Dollar General's performance was seen as more straightforward and indicative of sustained growth, leading to a stock rally. Dollar Tree's beat was more complex due to a significant one-time tariff refund, and its lower third-quarter EPS forecast caused its stock to decline.

feed.title: Camden Property Trust Acquired and Rebrands Multifamily Community in Nashville’s Gulch Neighborhood
feed.summary: Camden Property Trust has acquired the Harlowe multifamily community in Nashville's Gulch neighborhood for $88.6 million, or nearly $300,000 per unit. The 300-unit apartment complex, previously owned by Greystar, will be rebranded as Camden Gulch. This acquisition brings Camden Property Trust's total holdings in the Nashville area to six apartment developments.

feed.title: Larry Ellison Cancels His Plan to Sell Oracle Stock
feed.summary: Oracle Corporation announced that its Executive Chair of the Board and Chief Technology Officer, Larry Ellison, has cancelled his 10b5-1 Plan to sell Oracle stock. No stock was sold under this plan, and Ellison currently has no other plans to sell any of his Oracle stock.

feed.title: Costco fixed the one thing members hated about shopping there
feed.summary: Costco has significantly improved its digital sales and delivery services, with same-day delivery now averaging less than 45 minutes in the U.S. This strategic focus, spearheaded by CEO Ron Vachris, has led to impressive digital sales growth and high member satisfaction, reinforcing Costco's membership-driven business model. The company's cautious yet effective approach to technology investment aims to enhance member experience without replicating the extensive infrastructure of competitors like Amazon and Walmart.

feed.title: Jim Cramer on Oracle: $664B Backlog Signals Major Shift in Company’s Growth Trajectory
feed.summary: Jim Cramer highlighted Oracle's massive $664 billion revenue backlog, a significant increase from previous years, as a sign of dramatic growth opportunity. However, despite this positive outlook, the article points out underlying concerns such as substantial capital expenditures, negative free cash flow, and founder Larry Ellison's plan to sell $7.5 billion in stock. The company's stock is also significantly down year-over-year, prompting questions about how much of the backlog will convert to recognized revenue amidst funding challenges.

feed.title: Meta accused in class action of profiting from scam cryptocurrency ads
feed.summary: A new class action lawsuit has been filed against Meta Platforms Inc. and Instagram LLC, alleging that Meta profits from scam cryptocurrency ads displayed on its platforms. The plaintiffs claim Meta is aware of these fraudulent ads but fails to take adequate measures to stop them, instead using AI to optimize their effectiveness. The lawsuit seeks to represent a nationwide class of users who suffered losses from crypto scams promoted through these ads, suing for violations of California consumer laws and breach of contract.

feed.title: Prediction: Synopsys Could Be The Next AI Winner
feed.summary: Synopsys (NASDAQ: SNPS) is identified as a potential AI winner due to its position in silicon design software and engineering simulation, despite a 15.45% year-to-date pullback. The article highlights its strong Q3 FY2026 revenue growth of 42.4% and management's optimistic outlook on AI-driven demand and Ansys synergy. With a target price of $496.97, implying 25.13% upside, the stock is considered undervalued compared to its AI-driven earnings power and rivals like Cadence.

feed.title: Morgan Stanley delivers blunt message to America’s pet owners
feed.summary: Morgan Stanley reviewed Chewy's Q2 fiscal 2026 results, cutting its price target to $36 from $37 but maintaining an Overweight rating, despite the stock being down significantly year-to-date. The firm attributed the stock's recent sell-off to a "Treat-cession" where pet owners are tightening budgets, and noted that while Chewy's Q2 revenue and EBITDA guidance increased, organic growth decelerated and one-time items boosted EBITDA. Morgan Stanley suggests the upcoming redesign of the Chewy+ membership program and growth in its healthcare business could be catalysts for a future re-rating of the stock.

feed.title: Genesco (GCO) Proves Smaller Sales Can Still Mean Bigger Profits
feed.summary: Genesco (GCO) reported a strong second quarter, achieving increased profits despite a 3% dip in revenue by focusing on strategic initiatives and expense leverage. The company's Journeys brand saw its eighth consecutive quarter of positive comparable sales, driven by new store formats, while the Johnston & Murphy brand also performed well. However, the UK-based Schuh brand continues to face challenges due to a difficult consumer market, prompting revised full-year sales guidance.

feed.title: Vistra and NRG Escape Nuclear Selloff as UBS Exposes SMR Risk
feed.summary: On September 11, the nuclear energy sector experienced a significant selloff, primarily affecting advanced-reactor developers, while Vistra Corp. and NRG Energy saw their stocks rise. This divergence occurred after UBS downgraded NuScale Power, questioning its commercialization timeline and financial projections. The market's reaction highlighted a preference for companies with existing operational power assets and current earnings over those with speculative future projects in the advanced nuclear sector.

feed.title: Spotify vs. Netflix: I’d Bet on This Streaming Stock for the Next 5 Years
feed.summary: The article compares Spotify and Netflix's Q2 2026 performance and future prospects, arguing that Spotify offers more asymmetric upside due to its operating leverage, subscriber growth, and expanding gross margins. While Netflix is a safer, more profitable business, Spotify's strategy of flat headcount and new revenue streams like audiobooks makes it a more attractive bet for the next five years, despite its smaller market cap and recent stock performance.

feed.title: Spotify vs. Netflix: I’d Bet on This Streaming Stock for the Next 5 Years
feed.summary: This article compares Spotify and Netflix's recent quarterly performances and long-term strategies, concluding that Spotify offers more compelling upside. Spotify's focus on Premium subscribers, ARPU growth, and efficient operating leverage with flat headcount, coupled with new revenue streams like audiobooks, positions it for stronger growth over the next five years. feed.title: TEMPTU Launches on Ulta Beauty Marketplace, Expanding Access to Professional Airbrush Beauty
feed.summary: TEMPTU, a professional airbrush beauty brand, has launched its products on Ulta Beauty Marketplace, making its artist-trusted technology accessible to a wider audience. A curated selection of TEMPTU products became available on Ulta.com on September 8, with a special offer planned for Ulta Beauty’s 21 Days of Beauty event on September 12. This move signifies TEMPTU's expansion from a professional artistry essential to a brand serving both artists and general consumers.

feed.title: Medicus Pharma CEO on SkinJect and Pfizer partnership – ICYMI
feed.summary: Medicus Pharma's CEO, Raza Bokhari, discussed the company's progress with its SkinJect program, confirming the 200-microgram patch as the dose for future registrational studies and aiming for FDA approval for Gorlin syndrome. He also highlighted a co-development and licensing opportunity with Pfizer for a CD228-targeted antibody-drug conjugate, which comes with $2 million in funding and positions Medicus Pharma as a precision oncology-led biotech company. Bokhari sees potential catalysts for investors in SkinJect's development, a potential partnership, and the advancement of the Pfizer collaboration.

feed.title: Home Depot vs. Walmart: Which Consumer Stock Is a Better Buy in 2026?
feed.summary: This article compares Home Depot (HD) and Walmart (WMT) as investment opportunities in 2026, analyzing their business models, financial performance, risk profiles, and valuation metrics. While Home Depot is tied to the cyclical housing market, Walmart offers a defensive and predictable option due to its essential goods and everyday low pricing strategy, making it the preferred choice for the author despite its higher P/E ratio. The article aims to help investors decide which consumer stock might be a better buy.

feed.summary: Costamare Bulkers Holdings reported strong Q2 2026 results with adjusted net income of US$9.8 million and a net cash position of US$108.9 million after its spin-off from Costamare Inc. feed.title: Goldman Sachs Is Bullish. Here Are 3 Reasons AFRM Stock Could Climb 69%.
feed.summary: Goldman Sachs has raised its price target for Affirm Holdings (AFRM) to $115, implying a potential 69% upside, due to robust growth in interest-bearing loans, the Affirm Card, and strong Amazon volumes. Other financial firms also share this bullish sentiment, with the average target price around $99.48. Affirm's strong Q4 results, driven by expanding interest-bearing business, rapid Affirm Card adoption, and significant growth opportunities in e-commerce and other sectors, underscore the positive outlook.

feed.title: HCA CEO Sam Hazen: Mission must ‘earn’ community trust
feed.summary: HCA Healthcare CEO Sam Hazen addressed challenges at Mission Hospital, including staffing, patient flow, capacity, and community trust during a recent visit to Asheville. He acknowledged past shortcomings and outlined HCA's commitment to improving operations, expanding workforce, and rebuilding confidence by prioritizing patient care and employee satisfaction. Hazen emphasized that regaining trust requires earning it through transparent communication and continuous improvement, rather than simply asking for it.

feed.title: Xcel Energy's Day Of Service Brought St. Cloud Residents Together For Grounds Cleanup And Maintenance Work
feed.summary: Xcel Energy held its 16th Annual Day of Service in St. Cloud, bringing volunteers together to support the CentraCare Health Care Foundation. Volunteers performed various cleanup tasks at the Gorecki Guest House, including mulching, debris removal, gardening, and window washing. This event honors the victims and first responders of 9/11 and highlights Xcel Energy's ongoing commitment to community service, which saw over 2,900 participants contribute more than 8,900 hours last year.

feed.title: NXP Semiconductors Eyes Physical AI Leadership, Sees Data Center Growth Surge
feed.summary: NXP Semiconductors is strategically positioning itself as a leader in "physical AI" by integrating security, safety, real-time processing, and reliability into intelligent edge systems across various sectors like automotive, factories, and infrastructure. The company anticipates significant growth in its data center revenue, projecting an increase from $200 million last year to about $500 million this year, with continued growth expected next year. NXP is also focusing on software-defined vehicles as a major automotive growth driver and plans to shift towards a more asset-light manufacturing model.

feed.title: Boeing and engineers' union reach tentative contract agreement
feed.summary: Boeing and its engineering union, SPEEA, have reached a tentative four-year contract agreement, which includes higher general wage increases than a previously rejected offer. The deal, if approved by the 17,000 members, would provide a 10% wage raise initially, followed by 4% raises plus merit-based increases. This agreement is crucial for Boeing as SPEEA members are vital to certifying its 737 MAX 10 and 777-9 jets, both of which are significantly behind schedule.
